entities.summary: Mykola Serhiyovych Kravchenko was a Ukrainian public and political figure, historian, chief ideologue of the far-right Azov Battalion and one of the founders of the Ukrainian ultranationalist organization Patriot of Ukraine. He also served as the deputy leader of the far-right National Corps party. As a historian he researched the history of modern Ukrainian nationalist movement from the late 1980s - present.
